name: Sunita Chaudhary
quote: My daughter used to be shy about asking questions. After a year at STEAM Education she explains her science projects to the whole family at dinner.

name: Rajesh Thapa
quote: Both of my sons study here. What convinced us was the practical learning — they build things with their own hands, not just memorize books.

name: Kamala Gurung
quote: The teachers know every child by name and share updates with us regularly. As a first-time school parent, that care means everything.
